answer_1.quote: Advancements in data-to-text natural language generation (NLG) have evolved from seq2seq models ... We utilize the enhanced WebNLG'17 English dataset ... to convert structured data into readable text.
answer_1.outputs: Generated textual descriptions from RDF triples

answer_2.quote: evaluation was conducted using Meteor and Bleu. Additionally, we included the Comet neural metric ...

answer_3.quote: Semantic errors such as omissions, additions, and incorrect numbers and entities were identified using GPT-4o on 120 samples each.

answer_4.quote: Two of our authors served as human evaluators for four top models ... The evaluators were not informed about which models generated the samples ... they rated fluency and semantic adequacy on a 1-7 Likert scale ...
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators rated fluency and semantic adequacy on a 1-7 Likert scale and pairwise Mann-Whitney statistical tests were applied.
